about: L’Ancienne-Lorette is a city enclosed within Québec City’s urban area in Capitale-Nationale, near Jean Lesage International Airport. A distinct municipal government sits inside the capital’s fabric, with a traditional village core and residential streets rather than a separate countryside setting. About 16,000 people live in L’Ancienne-Lorette.
seoSummary: City enclave within Québec City near the airport, with its own municipal government and village core.
